scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.lint:packages: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:admin
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix admin run test
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix admin run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage && npm --prefix admin run test:coverage
scripts.update: npm --prefix backend update && npm --prefix frontend update && npm --prefix admin update
scripts.qa:all: npm run qa:coverage-report && npm run qa:flaky-tests:json
